title: Connected Building technical capability record

capabilities.name: IFC and historical room measurements
capabilities.scope: Nine IFC spaces, six monitored rooms, 37 channels and 285,954 original records. Source hashes, room associations and one unresolved channel are preserved.

capabilities.name: Relational and semantic services
capabilities.scope: SQLite-backed REST/GraphQL and executed fixed SPARQL over Oxigraph/RocksDB.

capabilities.name: Historical MQTT transport
capabilities.scope: Actual broker and clients, source-row receipts, duplicate handling and subscriber recovery.

capabilities.name: Chronological temperature forecasting
capabilities.scope: Chronological training, validation and test periods; persistence selected in all six room validation gates.

capabilities.name: Cloud-hosted application
capabilities.scope: Complete application deployed to Render Free. Runtime state uses temporary storage.

capabilities.name: Environmental sensor station
capabilities.scope: Authenticated temperature/humidity ingestion, separate station records, dashboard and retained-reading export are implemented. Local checks passed: 200 Python tests and 29 JavaScript tests. Both ESP32 firmware build checks passed. Physical commissioning follows equipment acquisition and authorised location/network setup.

data_scope: Published historical source data and new station observations have separate identities and stores. A new station is not assigned to a room in the source flat.
verification_policy: Each execution record identifies its revision, environment, date and checks. Sensor commissioning is recorded after the actual device is installed.
